commit_identity_policy: Resolve annotated tag after archive commit; no self-referential SHA
scope: Stages 1-3; no retraining, no historical rewrite, paper chapter deferred

protocol.temperature_policy: frozen training-wide per-N boundary calibration of same-round E0+Q

monitor_policy.users: fixed uniform training subset, at most 48; same seed across methods/epochs
monitor_policy.gradient_batches: first, middle (lower median), last actual rec-containing batch each epoch
monitor_policy.temperature_warning: gap/temperature changes >4x from initialization OR TopN soft mass <0.80
monitor_policy.warning_scope: exploratory diagnostic flags only; no training/selection/temperature changes
monitor_policy.Q_scope: same-parameter core vs fused ablation; cancellation association is not causal evidence

protocol.checkpoint_policy: minimum supervised BCE; last epoch reported separately
protocol.optimizer_policy: same original Adam/BCE/negative sampling/epochs/lr/batch size; no clipping or extra optimizer steps
protocol.protocol_scope: exploratory observed-history endpoint snapshot, inherited shared-preprocessing limitations
protocol.coefficient_status: lambdaE=0.01 exploratory value fixed before this pilot; not validated optimal
